$comment: Type-checks the files the shipped build never sees. tsconfig.json has rootDir=src and excludes *.spec.ts, so `bun x tsc` compiles neither prisma/seed.ts nor a single spec — and `bun test` executes the specs without checking them, so nothing in the repository type-checks them. This covers the seed, which is ordinary application code that has to agree with the schema. The specs are excluded on purpose: their Prisma fakes are deliberately loose, and typing them properly is a separate refactor rather than something to smuggle in with a CI gate.
